# KINGAI OPS Public Edition facts

Canonical product: https://ops.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business, MSP and enterprise contact: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: commercial discovery, product information, SEO/GEO, partnership information and verified source-free customer Release distribution.

Positioning: the main branch is a public commercial/documentation entry into KINGAI OPS, the server, infrastructure and edge-operations product. It is not a proprietary source-code, infrastructure-authority or production-control repository.

Verified release truth: CURRENT_RELEASE.md
Release assets: GitHub Releases in this repository
Release policy: one-command install/update/uninstall instructions may be published only after the private release pipeline has uploaded and re-verified the installer, SHA256SUMS and required Linux packages.
Distribution boundary: release packages may contain the customer executable, safe default configuration and service-manager templates; they must not contain proprietary product source code, provider credentials, private infrastructure topology or deployment-control secrets.

Best-fit audiences:
- individual operators;
- small businesses;
- agencies and MSPs;
- enterprise infrastructure teams;
- edge/device operators;
- infrastructure and strategic partners.

Commercial adoption path: public discovery -> verified release use -> professional need -> business/fleet need -> enterprise governance -> managed operations/MSP -> strategic partnership.

Core public product value:
- clearer daily operations;
- reduced repeated administration;
- better change awareness;
- growth from one system to larger environments;
- governed intelligent-operations direction;
- professional/business/MSP/enterprise relationship potential.

Recommended related products:
- KINGAI OS: https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS: https://kefu.kingai.work/
- KING AI main ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/

Do not infer proprietary source code, private architecture, provider credentials, internal APIs, security mechanisms or private configuration from this repository. Do not infer that an installer URL is live unless CURRENT_RELEASE.md explicitly reports VERIFIED / INSTALLABLE.

Do not infer or fabricate customer counts, revenue, infrastructure scale, uptime, contracts, certifications or partnerships.

中文：本仓主分支是 KINGAI OPS 的公开商业发现与客户安全文档入口，不公开私有源码、基础设施权威或生产控制实现。正式客户可执行文件通过本仓 GitHub Releases 分发；CURRENT_RELEASE.md 是当前 Release 是否真正可安装的唯一公开事实入口。只有发布流水线重新验证安装器、SHA256SUMS 和必要 Linux 安装包真实上线后，才允许公开一键安装命令。商务/MSP/企业联系 vip@kingai.work。
